decisions.reason: As a close-to-core turnaround product with clear strategic fit in integrated airport operations, it remains a cheap and valuable option to keep open while adoption continues to develop.
This connectivity module leverages the firm's installed base and integration capabilities, so continuation costs are likely low relative to its platform value.
Because billing software is less central to the firm's operational core, its abandonment risk is higher, but it still extends the digital offering enough to justify keeping it for now.
Equipment monitoring software fits strongly with the firm's engineering, maintenance, and lifecycle-service strengths, so keeping it preserves an attractive option at modest cost.
The safety alert service is strategically aligned but likely faces longer validation and sales cycles, making it sensible to retain despite a somewhat higher chance of later withdrawal.
